text:
lucas-finance: Heads up — NL tax office queried our treatment of SwissPartner invoices routed through our EU reseller flow (reverse-charge vs VAT). They want evidence of end-customer VAT IDs to accept reverse-charge.

vendor-support: We only collect VAT IDs for enterprise customers, not for SMBs; most orders came through reseller portal with limited buyer data.

erin-legal: Can you paste the NL auditor note? We need to see exact phrasing.

lucas-finance: Quote from inspector: "Insufficient proof of B2B status; tax benefit (reverse-charge) denied for transactions lacking valid EU VAT identification numbers and corresponding sales documentation." Ref NL/TAX/2026/RC-241.

tia-tax-consult: Two paths: 1) provide consolidated evidence per transaction (invoice with buyer VAT ID + contract) — likely only possible for enterprise buyers; 2) if missing, treat as B2C and charge VAT at place-of-supply — or request reseller to accept liability and register for OSS/non-union schemes. Recommend temporary remediation: flag affected SKUs as "no_reverse_charge" and issue corrected invoices where necessary.

maya-sales: Ouch — that will affect pricing on a bunch of SMB deals. Can we ask reseller to supply buyer VAT IDs retroactively? They might push back.

vendor-support: I'll pull the transaction list and mark which have buyer VAT IDs. Expect a CSV in ~3h.

erin-legal: We'll need to prepare a defensive disclosure pack if retro VAT is assessed. Also ask reseller for a contractual indemnity for missing buyer VAT evidence.

billing-bot: Tax action: bulk_update tag 'no_reverse_charge_pending_docs' applied to account SwissPartner. Auto-invoice pipeline will rerun with VAT rules set to destination-based for flagged transactions. Admin ticket FIN-4982 created.

lucas-finance: Thanks — once we have the CSV we'll decide which invoices to reissue vs issue supplemental VAT invoices. Also loop in partner success to manage reseller expectations.

maya-sales: I'll take point on partner comms and keep legal in the loop.

vendor-support: CSV uploaded to FIN drive: /shared/finance/SwissPartner_missing_vat_1769998888.csv — pinged in the ticket.

lucas-finance: Great. Follow-up: if reseller supplies valid VAT IDs within 30 days we can consider crediting VAT charges; otherwise finalize VAT collection. We'll reconvene after vendor-support's analysis.
